---
argument-hint: "[{plan.md}]"
---

Read either the supplied `{plan.md}>` or session memory (the PLAN) and
break it down into detailed implementation steps and acceptance criteria
in `.agentic/TASK-{NUM}.md` files.

Create a consolidating `.agentic/BLUEPRINT.md` bulleted list of checkable tasks
with format:

> - [ ] TASK-{NUM} - {DESCRIPTION} (ref: `TASK-{NUM}.md`)
